products.name: Double Sell Price
products.description: Every fish you sell at the market pays twice the coins, forever, in Lantern Lake.

products.name: Bait Belt
products.description: Equip up to 3 baits at once instead of 1. Their effects stack on every cast.

products.name: Starlight Yacht (VIP Boat)
products.description: Your own glowing Starlight Yacht: the fastest boat rides between waters and +10% fishing luck.

products.name: Auto-Reel
products.description: Adds an Auto-Reel switch: your reel plays the fight for you (auto-reeled catches never count as Perfect).

products.name: Rainbow Rod Skin
products.description: A rainbow look for your fishing rod. Cosmetic only: your rod keeps its own stats.

products.name: Dragon Rod Skin
products.description: A dragon look for your fishing rod, with glowing eyes at the tip. Cosmetic only: your rod keeps its own stats.

products.name: Candy Cane Rod Skin
products.description: A candy cane look for your fishing rod. Cosmetic only: your rod keeps its own stats.

products.name: Lucky Bait x3
products.description: 3 Lucky Bait. Each one gives 3 minutes of extra luck: rarer fish bite more often and shiny fish are twice as likely.

products.name: Double Sale
products.description: Sell your whole bag (except locked fish) at a market for double coins, once.

products.name: Re-hook
products.description: Re-hook a Rare or better fish that just escaped (within 45 seconds) and fight it again, once.
